name: Want More Clarity: Follow-Up Reading
purpose: A full-hour follow-up when your natal reading opened something you want to understand more deeply, or when new questions have emerged since we last met.
method: We begin with the natal foundation we have already established and focus the hour on the part of the chart, upcoming aspects, or questions you want to explore further. Because we already share the larger context, we can spend more time on what matters now.
bestFor: Established clients whose natal reading raised questions worth returning to
Going deeper into specific placements, patterns, or upcoming aspects
New questions that became clearer after you had time to sit with your original reading
notFor: New clients: the Natal Chart Reading comes first
priceLabel: $100 within 3 months of your reading · $130 after

options.label: Within 3 months of your natal reading

intakeRequirements: The parts of your chart or aspects you want to explore
includes: A deeper look at the part or parts of your chart you choose
Upcoming aspects examined in more detail when they are part of your question
Room to follow the questions that have become more important since your natal reading
preparation: Re-listen to your natal recording if helpful and note what you want to return to or understand more fully
